run_test_suite_models: run pytest on the models test suite with automatic GPU/CPU detection and report generation
run_test_suite_resume: resume an interrupted test run from a specific subdirectory using the resume-at argument
run_test_suite_parallel: split test execution across multiple processes using the processes argument for parallel CI runs
run_test_suite_important_models: run tests only for the important models subset using the only-in IMPORTANT_MODELS argument
run_test_suite_dry_run: print pytest commands without executing them using the dry-run argument for verification
